title: How to  Properly Heat a Pan
summary: A two-minute Rouxbe cooking-school demo of how to heat a pan properly before cooking. It uses the Leidenfrost effect, where water beads and skates across a hot pan, to show when a stainless steel pan is ready.
why: HN people cite it as a practical test for pan temperature and as the way to get a stainless steel pan relatively non-stick.

quote.text: This youtube video explains the process
